subject.title: Feature request: Mid-stream message injection (soft steer)

question: Should OpenClaw add a true soft-steer lifecycle that can abort or pause active generation/tool work, or keep steer as boundary delivery and use interrupt/followup modes for immediate replacement?
rationale: Current steer is a documented boundary-safe behavior; changing it requires maintainer intent because it affects session state, message delivery, transcript durability, and existing queue-mode expectations.

options.title: Add Opt-In Soft Steer
options.body: Introduce a separate soft-steer mode or setting with explicit abort/resume semantics and compatibility tests before changing existing default steer behavior.

options.title: Change Default Steer
options.body: Make the current steer mode abort/pause and resume active work by default, accepting the compatibility and state-machine risk as the new product direction.

options.title: Keep Boundary Steer
options.body: Leave steer as boundary delivery, direct users to interrupt/followup for immediate replacement, and close or narrow remaining soft-steer work after documenting that choice.

recommendation.title: Add Opt-In Soft Steer
recommendation.body: Introduce a separate soft-steer mode or setting with explicit abort/resume semantics and compatibility tests before changing existing default steer behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the most directly related maintainer-labeled steer lifecycle PR and are the clearest current routing candidate for this product/runtime decision.
